# Favicon Pack — generated by superdesigner.co

## Files
- favicon.ico          → Legacy browsers (16×16, 32×32, 48×48)
- favicon-16x16.png    → Browser tab
- favicon-32x32.png    → Browser tab (retina)
- apple-touch-icon.png → iOS home screen (180×180)
- android-chrome-192x192.png → Android home screen
- android-chrome-512x512.png → Android splash / PWA
- mstile-150x150.png   → Windows tiles
- site.webmanifest     → PWA manifest
- browserconfig.xml    → Windows / IE tile config
- favicon-tags.html    → Copy-paste HTML for <head>

## Deploy
Place all files in your web root (public/ or dist/).
Then paste the contents of favicon-tags.html into your <head>.
